name: aira-lumen-workspace
description: Public workspace for the Lumen deterministic educational-video renderer.

scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @aira/lumen-playground
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @aira/lumen-playground
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @aira/lumen && npm run build --workspace @aira/lumen-react && npm run build --workspace @aira/lumen-cartesia && npm run build --workspace @aira/lumen-mp4
